# Component selection by weighted factors (generated by rf2/rf2_select.py; MODELED)

Each slot's incumbent scores 1.00. A candidate's factor score is its ratio to the incumbent (better > 1, clipped 0.25-2); the slot score is the weighted mean of the factors the slot has. RECOMMEND at >= 1.05 with no hard-constraint failure and verification >= 0.6. Hard constraints (rule 6, rule 5 / no metal in the head, absolute maximum, fit) are never traded: a failure EXCLUDES the part, or BLOCKS it when it misses by 10 % or less (see docs/RULE_NEAR_MISSES.md).

Weights: mass_g 0.20, runtime_h 0.20, signal 0.20, margin 0.15, attach 0.10, footprint 0.10, verify 0.05. Baseline runtime: 2.6 h boost / 5.2 h scan.
